The operating vendor directly providing the software platform **Discord** at **discord.com** is **Discord Inc.**

### Supporting Evidence
According to Discord’s [Terms of Service](https://discord.com/terms):
* *"When we say “Discord,” “we,” “us,” and “our” in these terms, we mean Discord Inc., its subsidiaries, and its related companies. When we say “services” in these terms, we mean Discord's services, apps, websites, and other products."*
* *"Discord's services are provided by Discord Inc. We're located at 444 De Haro Street #200, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA."*
